name: SecondaryRectifier

ports.name: SEC_A
ports.meaning: Transformer secondary winding A (top winding), positive during first half-cycle

ports.name: SEC_B
ports.meaning: Transformer secondary winding B (bottom winding), positive during second half-cycle

ports.name: CT
ports.meaning: Center-tap combined output to output filter, rectified 12V nominal

ports.name: SR1_GATE
ports.meaning: Gate drive signal for SR1 FET from SR controller, controls SEC_A rectification

ports.name: SR2_GATE
ports.meaning: Gate drive signal for SR2 FET from SR controller, controls SEC_B rectification

rails_consumed.name: GND
rails_consumed.meaning: Common ground reference, SR FET sources return here

rails_consumed.name: +12V
rails_consumed.meaning: Gate drive supply voltage, derived from output rail for SR controller/driver VCC

notes: Body diodes conduct during dead time (normal operation)
Gate drive signals must have dead time - SR1 and SR2 never on simultaneously
Optional current sense resistors (10mΩ each) for telemetry - can be DNF
Gate drive implementation in separate SR_CONTROLLER block (discrete comparator + driver)
